experiment_template.research_question: Does one bounded same-digest tokenizer transport retry permit complete exposure of H23 without increasing cumulative model input plus output tokens?
stop_conditions: Every tokenizer attempt must have a receipt.
Only the common tokenizer transport policy may change.
Pause on another shared provider or instrument failure.

records.falsifier: The retry changes bytes or digest, exceeds one, reaches the model endpoint, hides either receipt, admits malformed/HTTP/credential failures, adds model tokens, or the separately frozen matrix still encounters an instrument stop.
records.mechanism: Retry at most once only at the stateless tokenizer endpoint after a typed request-failed response with zero response bytes. Use the identical serialized body and request digest. Do not retry model requests, HTTP responses, malformed tokenizer results, timeouts, credential failures, or any request with ambiguous model-token accounting.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: A single same-digest retry for a dispatched tokenizer request that receives no response can remove transient instrument censoring and permit the frozen GLM-5.3-flash 8K evidence-only ContextBench hypothesis to receive complete exposure without adding model input or output tokens.

experiment_template.research_question: Does delta state outperform one-shot evidence-only state?
stop_conditions: Do not select before H23 receives complete exposure.

records.falsifier: Delta state omits required evidence or fails native quality, completion, integrity, or token criteria.
records.mechanism: Project only facts added since the prior boundary while retaining objective identity and exact recovery handles.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: A receipt-bound delta containing only newly observed facts is sufficient for useful GLM-5.3-flash continuity at 8K with fewer model tokens.

experiment_template.research_question: Does state provide no criterion-complete benefit?

records.falsifier: A complete frozen state treatment clears native, validity, integrity and cumulative-token criteria.
records.mechanism: Deterministic evidence continuity cannot add the semantic judgment needed to select correct spans.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: Deterministic state does not reliably improve GLM-5.3-flash ContextBench outcomes at 8K because semantic interpretation is limiting.
